name: Cocoa pod husk (discarded at opening)
source: Fresh pod husk/rind: illustrative fibrous, low-fat, high-moisture proximate (per kg) water 800 g, protein 15 g, fat 3 g, carbohydrate/fibre 142 g, ash 40 g.
notes: Cocoa pod husk ash is real-world notably potassium-rich (it is composted or used directly as a potash soil amendment on cocoa farms); the ash split here is weighted accordingly. Standard elemental conversion factors as wheat-grain.json.
